WoW: Forever · Healer · Updated October 8, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70245 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Restoration build has been tested. Wild GrowthWild GrowthLevel 40 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost550 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration7 sec is the 31-point capstone, so level 40, and nobody in the beta has cast it. No source has posted a level 30 build either: the cap only reached 30 on October 1, and none of the three has published one since. The level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs, not a build any guide has recommended. Blizzard's own caveat: "class abilities and talents may continue to evolve throughout the beta test and are subject to additional changes."

What Restoration is for

Keeping a party up on heals that are already running before the damage lands. Gift of the EarthmotherGift of the EarthmotherTalentCastInstantReduces the global cooldown by 0.5 seconds on your Rejuvenation, Swiftmend, and Wild Growth spells. puts RejuvenationRejuvenationLevel 4 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 11CastInstantCost25 ManaRange40 yd rangeDuration12 secHeals the target for 32 over 12 sec., SwiftmendSwiftmendTalentCastInstantRange40 yd rangeCooldown15 sec cooldownInstantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of one of those spells. and Wild GrowthWild GrowthLevel 40 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost550 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration7 sec on a 1-second global cooldown, so you can blanket a group ahead of time. SwiftmendSwiftmendTalentCastInstantRange40 yd rangeCooldown15 sec cooldownInstantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of one of those spells. then turns one running RejuvenationRejuvenationLevel 4 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 11CastInstantCost25 ManaRange40 yd rangeDuration12 secHeals the target for 32 over 12 sec. or RegrowthRegrowthLevel 12 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 9Cast2 sec castCost70 ManaRange40 yd rangeDuration21 secHeals a friendly target for 87 and another 91 over 21 sec. into an instant heal for its full periodic duration, and leaves it ticking.

The published verdict measures solo kill speed, and it also says you can heal dungeons the whole way: "While it is very possible to level as a healing spec like Restoration Druid, it will result in a much longer journey than levelling as Feral or Balance instead. You will be very hard to kill, but our damage is just too low to do the job efficiently. If you're open to the other specs, then it can be best to level as one of those, and you can still heal dungeons while you level if you like." Blizzard's own class deep dive backs the same complaint at class level: Druid healing "relies on healing-over-time spells that require more planning."

Level Feral, then respec to Restoration when you want to heal. Druid respeccing costs the same as anyone's.

Details on how Legacy points are earned are not yet published.

Stat priority

Healing Power and Spell Power equally, then Intellect, Spirit, critical strike, Haste.

"Intellect decides how long you can keep casting, Spirit how quickly the bar refills once you stop. Stamina counts for very little here, and spell damage for nothing." Icy Veins places Haste last for the same reason: healing over time does not scale with haste at all, and there are no haste breakpoints for it.

Item level first while levelling: take the higher piece.
